summary: The judge schedule contains at most ten calls, and each optimal invocation cancels at most one timeout and schedules exactly one replacement, so the legal domain is too small for an honest runtime scaling regression.

workload_bound.source_constraint: calls.length is an integer from 1 through 10

replacement_checks.evidence: The closure retains one timeout handle; every invocation performs one cancellation attempt and one timer registration.
Authored cases cover zero and maximum delay, one and ten calls, same-time replacement, quiet intervals, repeated cancellation, and argument forwarding.
